set_desc: Author FSoundAttenuationSettings on a USoundAttenuation via reflection (partial merge + clamp).
settings_desc: Object of FSoundAttenuationSettings/FBaseAttenuationSettings fields to merge; absent keys untouched. e.g. bAttenuate, bSpatialize, attenuationShape(Sphere/Capsule/Box/Cone), distanceAlgorithm, falloffDistance, dBAttenuationAtMax(-60..0), attenuationShapeExtents{x,y,z}, bAttenuateWithLPF, lPFFrequencyAtMin/Max, bEnableOcclusion, occlusionVolumeAttenuation, bEnableReverbSend, reverbWetLevelMin/Max. Nested plugin sub-objects (pluginSettings, audioLinkSettingsOverride) are NOT authored here.
get_desc: Read all FSoundAttenuationSettings fields from a USoundAttenuation.
